claims.text: An exact first-week run/walk protocol can be offered as bounded establishment, not as a universal safe/optimal dose.

confidence.rationale: Exact published novice protocol available; outcome evidence rejects prevention certainty; hybrid transfer conditional.

claims.population: Adult nonclinical novice recreational runner, current walking context/cue comprehension; no simultaneous novel Strength progression
claims.limits: Eligibility/current capacity is not guaranteed by label/walk test. Day variants are DECIDED logistical transfers.

claims.text: Healthy adults can benefit from multiple RT configurations; low-volume establishment is possible, but exact1x8/120s first-week adequacy is a protocol choice.

confidence.rationale: Current position stand and NMA support broad RT approaches; exact protocol and hybrid transfer not tested.

counterevidence: R2-S03 limitations: supervised chronic studies; many acute variables not analysed
claims.population: Healthy adult RT novice/intermediate; no autonomous unsupervised safety inference
claims.limits: 1set is establishment, not full hypertrophy optimization; no precise load generated from class. S03/S04 overlap.

claims.text: RIR and task technique require configuration-specific interpretation; RIR2/4 cannot be presumed accurate from experience label.

confidence.rationale: Current supervised primary study demonstrates persistent task/target error despite practice.

counterevidence: R2-S11: practice improved accuracy but did not establish universal precise transfer
claims.population: Recreational adults; limited direct transfer to novice4-machine or squat
claims.limits: Do not reproduce repeated failure-test protocol; numeric target emitted only when explicit task-specific calibration supplied.

claims.text: Concurrent demand overlap alone does not prove acute/chronic interference or necessity; endpoint, actual dose, timing, context and response matter.

confidence.rationale: Chronic and acute reviews show outcome- and protocol-dependent results; exact individual response remains unknown.

counterevidence: R2-S05: explosive-strength versus maximal-strength findings differ
R2-S06: some acute outcomes unchanged, performance reporting heterogeneous
claims.population: Healthy adults/runners in study protocols; not clinical
claims.limits: No universal minimum hours, automatic deletion of Strength or global fatigue score.

claims.text: Task-specific performance and subjective recovery can inform a bounded candidate comparison; they do not identify an exact required set/repetition reduction.

confidence.rationale: Monitoring supports context, while acute review does not quantify individual rescue dose.

counterevidence: R2-S07: subjective/objective association inconsistent; indexed only by author
R2-S06: adverse acute outcomes not universal
claims.population: Athlete monitoring; exact V1 witness demands independently admissible/familiar candidate
claims.limits: Exact reduction derives from current observed admissible task candidate plus independent judgment, never a fatigue-score formula.

claims.text: Prior tolerance can retain configuration/history context after a nonclinical pause but cannot establish current capacity or a universal return percentage.

confidence.rationale: Detraining literature shows variable loss; no direct recipe law; present demonstrated capacity is deliberately required.

counterevidence: R2-S13: small bench-only retraining can recover; this does not specify first-return hybrid dose
claims.population: Previously familiar recreational adult; interruption reason explicitly nonclinical
claims.limits: Unknown present capacity -> ASK/own establishment. Clinical return stays human. Days since pause are descriptive, not dosing parameter.

claims.text: No10% or other universal percentage progression/injury-prevention rule is justified by these data.

confidence.rationale: Final randomized trial directly failed to support injury-prevention advantage of tested graded schedule; this is not equivalence/safety proof.

claims.population: Novice event-training trial; no claim absence of all useful progression bounds
claims.limits: No target arbitrary percentage imposed; single success cannot create repeated increment loop.

claims.text: Endurance taper evidence supports a direction of lower volume retaining relevant intensity, with population/protocol limits.

confidence.rationale: Applicable endurance systematic synthesis; recreational hybrid combined recipe indirect.

counterevidence: R2-S08: few RCTs, mostly male trained endurance cohorts and heterogeneous responses
claims.population: Endurance study populations; transfer to bounded familiar recreational hybrid is conditional
claims.limits: Pooled subgroup percentages not individual taper law; exact seven-day week is DECIDED composition.

claims.text: The exact1x5 three-machine exposure is not proven to preserve every strength adaptation through a hybrid event week.

confidence.rationale: No direct combined exact protocol trial found in bounded search; indirect narrative maintenance evidence cannot supply it.

counterevidence: Maintenance studies in mostly general populations and different prescriptions cannot establish hybrid1x5 optimality.
claims.limits: Not used as decisive positive claim. Protocol may preserve intent only; if preservation of adaptation is necessary, dependent decision remains unsupported.

claims.text: CS, LT2, MLSS, race pace and familiar field-session targets must remain distinct, with method-specific calibration and comparison.

confidence.rationale: Current open scoping review directly rejects interchangeability; measurement protocols/context vary.

claims.population: Running measurement; no generic first-ever hard-session calibration
claims.limits: HR/RPE/pace/power do not turn labels into physiological constructs by default. No arbitrary target crosswalk.

claims.text: Comparable athlete observations may rank existing admissible options descriptively, without establishing causality or new dose bounds.

confidence.rationale: A bounded inference/measurement rule; effectiveness of learning heuristic is unvalidated and retained as hypothesis.

claims.population: Synthetic learned-history witnesses only; not empirical person-specific causal model
claims.limits: No magic minimum count; witness guards are operational; runtime cannot expand admissibility from ranking.

classificationKey.OBSERVED: Directly read findings confined to source population
classificationKey.DECIDED: Operational design choice, not a scientific fact

independence: SSCTR disposition and source/reasoning audit are separate authored-instance records.
missingExactEvidence: C09 is explicitly open and cannot support a maintenance promise. Exact finite doses/operational bounds remain choices requiring independent judgment.
